subproblem.title: Tangent measures via (DTC): localized blow-ups of the weight of a minimizing cycle subconverge vaguely to the weight of a minimizing cone cycle with homogeneous density (parent steps 4(e), 5 with (F4), (F5), (F7), (F8))
subproblem.statement: Assume (DTC). (DTC) is the contract proposition DensityAndTangentCones (Simon 7.3.1): for n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅ and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N: (1) there is Θ with HasMassDensity T x (Θ x) on U ∖ spt ∂T, upper semicontinuous there; (2) for every x ∈ spt T ∖ boundarySupport T and every sequence λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0 there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) with blowUp T x λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C (ConvergesWeakly), MassMeasuresConverge for these blow-ups and C, IsMinimizingIn C univ, IsConeCurrent C, and a common density θ of T at x and of C at 0. For a measure ν on ℝ^{n+k}, a point a and s > 0 write ν^{a,s} := ofReal(s^{−n})•ν.map(dilation a s), and r_ν(w, ρ) := ν(B_ρ(w))/(unitBallVolume n·ofReal(ρ^n)). (A) Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, U, N, G ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with U and G open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U, R an IMRep of T in U, p ∈ U with p ∈ G, and λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0. Then there are a strictly increasing sub : ℕ → ℕ, a current C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂C = 0, and an IMRep R_C of C in ℝ^{n+k} such that, with μ_C := R_C.measure, limsup_{ρ→0⁺} r_{μ_C}(t·w, ρ) = limsup_{ρ→0⁺} r_{μ_C}(w, ρ) for all t > 0 and w, and ∫ f d(R.measure⌞G)^{p,λ_{sub(j)}} → ∫ f dμ_C for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ. (B) For n, k ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} with ∂S = 0, every IMRep R of S in ℝ^{n+k}, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, the same conclusion holds with (R.measure)^{y,λ_{sub(j)}} in place of (R.measure⌞G)^{p,λ_{sub(j)}}.

subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent step 4(e) and step 5 with basic facts (F4), (F5), (F7), (F8); Simon 7.3.1(2) (existence of tangent cones; statement chapter-07.txt lines 302–310, proof from line 326) and 7.3.3, proof of 3.3(1), (8) (chapter-07.txt lines 454–466: limits of blow-ups at scales tending to 0 minimize in all of ℝ^{n+ℓ}).
Notation: P := n + k; ω_n := unitBallVolume n ∈ (0, ∞); η_{a,s} := dilation a s; μ := R.measure. 'Vague convergence' of ν_j to ν means ∫ f dν_j → ∫ f dν for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ.
Part (A).
1. (Localization.) G is open and p ∈ G, so fix δ > 0 with B_δ(p) ⊆ G. For s > 0, by the sibling ambient_calculus (9) (with B := G, Borel), (μ⌞G)^{p,s} = (μ^{p,s})⌞η_{p,s}(G), and η_{p,s}(G) ⊇ η_{p,s}(B_δ(p)) = B_{δ/s}(0) (ambient_calculus (4), η_{p,s}(p) = 0). Let f be continuous with compact support; then tsupport f ⊆ closedBall 0 M_f for some M_f ≥ 0. If tsupport f ⊆ B_{δ/s}(0) ⊆ η_{p,s}(G), then ∫ f d(μ⌞G)^{p,s} = ∫_{η_{p,s}(G)} f dμ^{p,s} = ∫ f dμ^{p,s} (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero, since f = 0 off tsupport f; η_{p,s}(G) is open, hence measurable). Because δ/λ_j → ∞, tsupport f ⊆ B_{δ/λ_j}(0) for all large j. Hence for every subsequence, the integrals of f against (μ⌞G)^{p,λ_{sub(j)}} and μ^{p,λ_{sub(j)}} are eventually equal, and a limit of one sequence is a limit of the other (Tendsto.congr').
2. (Case p ∉ spt T; (F4) and (F8).) By the sibling im_mass_measure (b) (U open, R represents T, p ∈ U), there is ε > 0 with μ(B_ε(p)) = 0, hence (μ⌞G)(B_ε(p)) = 0. For s > 0, ambient_calculus (2),(3) give (μ⌞G)^{p,s}(B_{ε/s}(0)) = ofReal(s^{−n})·(μ⌞G)(B_ε(p)) = 0 (η_{p,s}^{−1}(B_{ε/s}(0)) = B_ε(p)). For f continuous with compact support and j so large that tsupport f ⊆ B_{ε/λ_j}(0): ∫ f d(μ⌞G)^{p,λ_j} = ∫_{B_{ε/λ_j}(0)} f + ∫_{complement} f = 0 + 0 (the first set is null; f vanishes on the second). So these integrals are eventually 0. Take sub := id, C := 0 ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and R_C := the empty triple (carrier ∅, multiplicity 1, orientation 0). R_C is an IMRep: ∅ is measurable and ⊆ univ; CountablyRectifiable n ∅ (countablyRectifiable_of_measure_zero, μHE[n] ∅ = 0); the multiplicity is measurable and positivity on ∅ is vacuous; ∫⁻ over ∅ ∩ K is 0 ≠ ∞; Hⁿ.restrict ∅ = 0, so a.e. strong measurability and the a.e. orientation condition hold trivially. R_C.action(ω) = ∫ over ∅ = 0 = 0(ω), so R_C represents 0, and R_C.measure = 0. The zero current is integer multiplicity, and minimizing in ℝ^P: M_W(0) = sSup((ω ↦ ofReal(0(ω))) '' admissible) ≤ 0 ≤ M_W(S') for every competitor S'. ∂0 = 0 (write n = m + 1; (0).boundary(ω) = 0(dω) = 0, GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Every density ratio of the zero measure is 0, so both limsups are 0 and homogeneity holds. Finally ∫ f d0 = 0, and the integrals against (μ⌞G)^{p,λ_j} are eventually 0, so they converge to ∫ f dμ_C.
3. (Case p ∈ spt T: apply (DTC)(2).) Since n ≥ 1 and ∂T = 0, boundarySupport T = spt(∂T) = spt 0 = ∅: every q ∈ U has ε > 0 with closedBall q ε ⊆ U (U open); W := B_ε(q) is open with compact closure ⊆ closedBall q ε ⊆ U, and the zero current vanishes on W, so q ∈ zeroRegion 0 and spt 0 = U ∖ zeroRegion 0 = ∅. Thus p ∈ spt T ∖ boundarySupport T. (DTC) applied to n, k, ℓ, U, N, T (hypotheses among ours), the point p and the sequence (λ_j) gives a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with (a) ConvergesWeakly (blowUp T p λ_{φ(j)}) C, (b) MassMeasuresConverge for these blow-ups and C, (c) IsMinimizingIn C univ, (d) IsConeCurrent C. Put sub := φ.
4. (∂C = 0, (F7).) The sequence λ'_j := λ_{φ(j)} is positive and tends to 0 (φ strictly increasing, StrictMono.tendsto_atTop). The sibling blowup_limit_cycle (Submission.idtp_tpf_blowUp_limit_boundaryVanishes with U open, x := p ∈ U, BoundaryVanishes T, λ'_j → 0 and (a)) gives BoundaryVanishes C.
5. (Weights converge.) By (c), C is integer multiplicity; fix an IMRep R_C of C in univ. For each j, the sibling blowup_scaling (2) (Submission.dtc_blowUp_scaling, U open, 0 < n) gives an IMRep R_j of blowUp T p λ'_j in η_{p,λ'_j}(U) with R_j.measure(s) = ofReal(λ'_j^{−n})·μ(η^{−1}(s)) for Borel s; by ambient_calculus (2) and Measure.ext, R_j.measure = μ^{p,λ'_j}. Apply (b) to the family (R_j) (chosen by choice), to R_C and to any continuous compactly supported f (tsupport f ⊆ univ): ∫ f dμ^{p,λ'_j} → ∫ f dμ_C. By step 1 the same holds for (μ⌞G)^{p,λ'_j}.
6. (Homogeneous density, (F5).) By (d) and the sibling cone_measure_homogeneous (Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image, R_C represents the cone C), μ_C((v ↦ t v) '' A) = ofReal(t^n)·μ_C(A) for t > 0 and Borel A. Fix t > 0 and w. For ρ > 0, B_ρ(t w) = (v ↦ t v) '' B_{ρ/t}(w) (smul_ball, t ≠ 0, ‖t‖ = t), so μ_C(B_ρ(t w)) = ofReal(t^n)·μ_C(B_{ρ/t}(w)), and ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n) = ofReal(t^n)·(ω_n·ofReal((ρ/t)^n)) (ρ = t·(ρ/t), mul_pow, ENNReal.ofReal_mul). Since ofReal(t^n) ∈ (0, ∞), r_{μ_C}(t w, ρ) = r_{μ_C}(w, ρ/t) for every ρ > 0 (ENNReal.mul_div_mul_left). The set {ρ > 0} belongs to 𝓝[>]0, so the limsups of ρ ↦ r_{μ_C}(t w, ρ) and of ρ ↦ r_{μ_C}(w, ρ/t) along 𝓝[>]0 agree (Filter.limsup_congr). The map ρ ↦ ρ/t = t^{−1}ρ is an order isomorphism of ℝ fixing 0, so Filter.map (· / t) 𝓝[>]0 = 𝓝[>]0, and limsup (h ∘ (·/t)) 𝓝[>]0 = limsup h (map (·/t) 𝓝[>]0) = limsup h 𝓝[>]0 (Filter.limsup_comp) for h := r_{μ_C}(w, ·). This is the homogeneity in (A).
7. Steps 2 and 3–6 give the conclusion of (A) in the two cases p ∉ spt T and p ∈ spt T.
Part (B).
8. Apply (A) with ℓ := k, U = N = G := ℝ^{n+k}, T := S, R and p := y. Its hypotheses hold: univ is open; IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + k) univ by the sibling ambient_calculus (1) (P := n + k); (closure univ ∖ univ) ∩ univ = ∅; univ ∩ univ = univ, so IsMinimizingIn S (univ ∩ univ) and spt S ⊆ univ ∩ univ; ∂S = 0; y ∈ univ. As R.measure⌞univ = R.measure (Measure.restrict_univ), the conclusion of (A) is that of (B). ∎
proof_key_steps: Localization: on B_{δ/s}(0) the blow-ups of μ⌞G and μ at p agree (ambient_calculus (9),(4)), so their integrals against a fixed f ∈ C_c agree at small scales.
Off spt T a null ball makes the blow-up integrals eventually 0; the zero current with the empty IMRep is a minimizing cycle with weight 0.

At p ∈ spt T (spt ∂T = ∅), (DTC)(2) gives a minimizing cone C with weak convergence and MassMeasuresConverge; blowup_limit_cycle gives ∂C = 0 and blowup_scaling identifies the blow-up weights with μ^{p,λ}.
cone_measure_homogeneous gives μ_C(tA) = t^nμ_C(A), so r(tw, ρ) = r(w, ρ/t) and the limsups along 𝓝[>]0 coincide.
(B) is (A) with U = N = G = ℝ^{n+k}, using ambient_calculus (1).
